headline: Opskeep now helps accountants and anyone who bills clients for their time.
highlights: A new accounting pack: client record requests, month-end reconciliations, a filing-deadline calendar for every client, and plain-language management reports.
See who owes you money and how late, with ready-to-send reminder drafts.
See unbilled hours and expenses per client before you invoice, and mark them billed afterwards.
Expenses are now totalled per currency, so cedis and dollars are never added together.

verticals.update: git -C <clone folder> pull, then copy verticals/<pack>/skills/* into the agent's skills folder again
